about_pullquote: I started this because I was tired seeing people overcharged in their moment of panic.
about_para_1: Jackson Keys Locksmith was founded on a simple principle: when someone's locked out or broken a key, they need help fast and fairly. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Winterbourne and Bristol for turning up on time, solving the problem properly, and charging an honest price. We're a local, independent business — no franchises, no surprises, just skilled locksmiths who know the area.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat every call seriously, whether it's a midnight emergency or a routine lock repair. We carry a full range of locks and tools on the van, so most jobs are finished in a single visit. You'll speak to the locksmith who'll be helping you — no call centres, no delays.
reviews_heading: What Winterbourne and Bristol Residents Say

reviews.text: Lost my keys on the way home from work on a Friday evening. Called Jackson Keys and they were at my door in 35 minutes. Sorted the lock in minutes, very friendly, and the price was fair. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had a broken cylinder lock on my front door and wasn't sure what to do. The locksmith explained the options clearly, fitted a new one quickly, and even gave me spare keys cut for free. Great service, will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Our office was broken into overnight and the lock was damaged. Jackson Keys came the next morning, replaced the whole mechanism, and even advised on extra security. Professional, no nonsense, fair price.
reviews.author: Robert H.
